EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
The Big Picture: Modernizing Campus Life Through Mobile Technology
CORE PURPOSE
The Mission
  • Solve campus event fragmentation across engineering departments.
  • Replace paper circulars, unread noticeboards, and chaotic WhatsApp forwards.
  • Provide a centralized, live digital timetable accessible to every student on Android.
SECURITY FOCUS
Institutional Identity
  • Restricted strictly to verified @gmail.com & college email IDs.
  • Eliminate unauthorized external spam and unverified participant data.
  • Row-Level Security (RLS) ensures students modify only their own RSVP records.
IMPACT & RESULTS
Tangible Value
  • Instant 1-click RSVP with real-time seat decrementing to prevent hall overflow.
  • One-tap calendar synchronization directly into Google Calendar & system alerts.
  • Zero memory leaks, sub-second queries, and universal APK compatibility.

Current Roadblocks in Campus Event Management
BOTTLENECK 1
Fragmented Information
  • Announcements scattered across classrooms, noticeboards, and chat groups.

  • Multiple student clubs book auditoriums simultaneously without coordination.

Security & Manual Forms
  • Coordinators rely on unverified Google Forms and physical paper rosters.
  • Open forms invite fake registrations and compromised student privacy.
  • Manual tracking consumes faculty hours and delays event schedules.

SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
Decoupled 3-Tier Enterprise Cloud Architecture
TIER 1 : PRESENTATION
React Native + Expo SDK 52 (Mobile Client)
Universal Android APK with Hermes JS bytecode engine. Expo Router file-based navigation (Tabs + Native Stack), Dark Theme UI.
TIER 2 : SERVICE LAYER
Supabase PostgREST & Auth Microservices
Stateless HTTPS JSON API gateway handling authentication, session tokens, and RFC-5322 regex validation.
TIER 3 : PERSISTENCE
PostgreSQL 15 Relational Database + RLS
ACID-compliant normalized storage for profiles, events, and RSVPs with Row-Level Security policies.
DATA FLOW PIPELINE
End-to-End Sequence
  • 1. User Launch: App initiates via Hermes bytecode in ~1.1s.
  • 2. Domain Check: Validates institutional credentials (@gmail.com).
  • 3. Encrypted Transit: Sends HTTPS requests with JWT bearer tokens.
  • 4. Security Kernel: PostgreSQL evaluates Row-Level Security rules.
  • 5. Atomic RSVP: Decrements available capacity and returns digital pass.
  • 6. Local Caching: React Query synchronizes data for offline access.
SECURITY & COMPLIANCE
Department of CSE (Cyber Security) Standards & Protocols
SECURITY PILLAR 1
Institutional Domain Filtering
Strict RFC-5322 regex validation enforcing authorized @gmail.com & institutional accounts. Rejects disposable emails and external spam.
SECURITY PILLAR 2
PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS)
Policies compiled into database engine. Students can only view public events and modify personal registrations. Coordinators manage departmental data.
SECURITY PILLAR 3
Encrypted JWT Session Management
Tokens signed with SHA-256 HMAC and saved in hardware-backed SecureStore. Immutable sign-in audit logs record IP, device, and timestamps.
DATABASE DESIGN
ACID-Compliant Relational Schema on PostgreSQL
SCHEMA MODULE 1
Profiles & Identity
  • Table: profiles
  • Columns: id (UUID PK), email (UNIQUE), full_name, role, college_id, created_at.
  • Linked with Supabase auth.users.
  • Maintains user authentication state and role-based permissions.
SCHEMA MODULE 2
Events & Categories
  • Table: events, categories
  • Columns: id (UUID PK), title, description, event_date, location, category_id, organizer_id, max_capacity.
  • Normalized category codes (ACAD, CULT, SPORT, TECH).
  • Maintains hard seating quotas and hall bookings.
SCHEMA MODULE 3
Registrations & Auditing
  • Table: event_registrations, auth_logs
  • Columns: id, event_id, user_id, status, ticket_token, registered_at.
  • Unique composite key prevents duplicate RSVPs.
  • Comprehensive login and audit trails for compliance.

Chronological Event Discovery & Category Filtering
USER EXPERIENCE
Frictionless Discovery Feed

CORE CAPABILITY 2
Real-Time Multi-Attribute Search Engine
SEARCH ALGORITHM
Instant Query Feedback
  • Multi-Field Querying: Matches across event titles, seminar venues, and organizer names simultaneously.
  • Debounced Input (250ms): Prevents unnecessary database queries during rapid student typing.
  • Graceful Empty State: Friendly prompt when no events match, with helpful suggestions.
  • Sub-100ms Query Latency: Indexed PostgreSQL columns deliver instantaneous search results.
  • Always Accessible: Integrated search shortcut directly on the main navigation bar.
CORE CAPABILITY 3
1-Click RSVP & Concurrency-Safe Seat Quota
BOOKING ENGINE
Capacity Integrity
  • Full Event Details: Complete speaker bio, venue guidelines, time slots, and attendee lists.
  • Atomic Seat Allocation: Dynamic countdown decrements seating quota immediately upon booking.
  • Duplicate RSVP Prevention: Database constraints guarantee students cannot register twice.
  • One-Tap Cancellation: Easily surrender seat reservations, returning quotas to fellow peers.
  • Cryptographic Ticket Pass: Generates unique digital booking reference token (e.g. T-2026-0418).

COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS
CAMPUS EVENTS vs. Traditional Collegiate Methods
LEGACY APPROACH
Notice Boards & Google Forms
  • Paper Circulars: Rapidly obsolete, torn, or missed by commuting students.
  • Noisy WhatsApp Groups: Essential notices drowned in hundreds of casual chats.
  • Open Forms: Zero domain verification; susceptible to fake registrations.
  • Manual Tallying: Coordinators manually track spreadsheets, causing hall overflow.
  • No Calendar Integration: Students must manually type event times into phones.
  • Zero Offline Utility: Cannot view registration passes without internet.
PROPOSED SOLUTION
CAMPUS EVENTS Mobile Platform
  • Centralized Feed: Live schedule accessible anytime, anywhere on mobile.
  • Instant Category Filters: Find relevant workshops by branch in 1 tap.
  • Domain Verification: Restricts access to verified @gmail.com accounts.
  • Dynamic Capacity: Atomic seat countdown locks bookings when capacity is reached.
  • Google Calendar Sync: 1-tap export directly into Google Calendar with alarms.
  • Offline Resilience: View confirmed passes offline inside seminar basements.
